LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 你提著一大包東西，要去哪裡啊？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 你提着一大包东西，要去哪里啊？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Nǐ tízhe yí dà bāo dōngxi, yào qù nǎlǐ a?
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: You’re carrying a large bag of things; where are you off to?

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我要去便利商店送洗衣服。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我要去便利商店送洗衣服。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn sòngxǐ yīfu.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: I’m going to the convenience store to send clothes for dry cleaning.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 臺灣的便利商店有送洗衣服的服務，我怎麼不知道？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 台湾的便利商店有送洗衣服的服务，我怎么不知道？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu sòngxǐ yīfu de fúwù, wǒ zěnme bù zhīdào?
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Taiwan’s convenience stores have laundry services? How did I not know?

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 早就有了，挺方便的。我剛到臺灣時，跟朋友去便利商店，被嚇了一跳。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 早就有了，挺方便的。我刚到台湾时，跟朋友去便利商店，被吓了一跳。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Zǎo jiù yǒu le, tǐng fāngbiàn de. Wǒ gāng dào Táiwān shí, gēn péngyou qù biànlì shāngdiàn, bèi xià le yí tiào.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: They’ve had it for a long time; it’s quite convenient. When I first arrived in Taiwan, I went to a convenience store with a friend and was shocked.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 怎麼了？被什麼事嚇了一跳？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 怎么了？被什么事吓了一跳？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Zěnme le? Bèi shénme shì xià le yí tiào?

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我沒想到臺灣的便利商店有這麼多服務。像領錢、買票，還有收電話費、水電費什麼的。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我没想到台湾的便利商店有这么多服务。像领钱、买票，还有收电话费、水电费什么的。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu zhème duō fúwù. Xiàng lǐngqián, mǎipiào, hái yǒu shōu diànhuàfèi, shuǐdiànfèi shénmede.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: I never expected Taiwan’s convenience stores to offer so many services. Like withdrawing money, buying tickets, plus collecting phone bills, utilities, and so on.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 對，真的很多。我覺得現在臺灣的便利商店比以前方便，比如說，提供休息空間，讓客人坐下來，好好地吃個東西、喝點飲料。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 对，真的很多。我觉得现在台湾的便利商店比以前方便，比如说，提供休息空间，让客人坐下来，好好地吃个东西、喝点饮料。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Duì, zhēnde hěn duō. Wǒ juéde xiànzài Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn, bǐrú shuō, tígōng xiūxí kōngjiān, ràng kèrén zuò xiàlai, hǎohāode chī ge dōngxi, hē diǎn yǐnliào.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Right, really a lot. I feel Taiwan’s convenience stores now are more convenient than before; for instance, providing seating areas so customers can sit down and comfortably have a bite to eat or drink a beverage.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 是啊。現在我早晚都去，有時候整個下午都在那裡看書、寫功課。如果餓了，就順便買個泡麵，還能免費使用熱水，真方便。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 是啊。现在我早晚都去，有时候整个下午都在那里看书、写功课。如果饿了，就顺便买个泡面，还能免费使用热水，真方便。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ zǎowǎn dōu qù, yǒu shíhou zhěng ge xiàwǔ dōu zài nàlǐ kànshū, xiě gōngkè. Rúguǒ è le, jiù shùnbiàn mǎi ge pàomiàn, hái néng miǎnfèi shǐyòng rèshuǐ, zhēn fāngbiàn.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Yeah. Now I go both morning and night; sometimes I spend the whole afternoon there reading and doing homework. If I get hungry, I casually buy instant noodles, and can even use hot water for free; it’s really convenient.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我來不及做早餐的話，就去那裡買個饅頭、牛奶。有時候也去買最愛的熱狗跟汽水，雖然沒什麼營養，但是可以讓心情變得更好，哈哈哈！
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我来不及做早餐的话，就去那里买个馒头、牛奶。有时候也去买最爱的热狗跟汽水，虽然没什么营养，但是可以让心情变得更好，哈哈哈！
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ láibují zuò zǎocān dehuà, jiù qù nàlǐ mǎi ge mántou, niúnǎi. Yǒu shíhou yě qù mǎi zuì ài de règǒu gēn qìshuǐ, suīrán méi shénme yíngyǎng, dànshì kěyǐ ràng xīnqíng biàn de gèng hǎo, hāhāhā!
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: If I don’t have time to make breakfast, I go there to buy a steamed bun and milk. Sometimes I also buy my favorite hot dog and soda; although not very nutritious, it puts me in a better mood, hahaha!

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 是啊。對了，我聽說日本的便利商店也很方便，商品也很多。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 是啊。对了，我听说日本的便利商店也很方便，商品也很多。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Shì a. Duì le, wǒ tīngshuō Rìběn de biànlì shāngdiàn yě hěn fāngbiàn, shāngpǐn yě hěn duō.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Yeah. By the way, I heard convenience stores in Japan are also very convenient, and have lots of merchandise.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 跟臺灣的差不多。從中餐、西餐，到白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果都買得到，也有各式各樣的生活用品。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 跟台湾的差不多。从中餐、西餐，到白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果都买得到，也有各式各样的生活用品。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Gēn Táiwān de chàbùduō. Cóng zhōngcān, xīcān, dào báicài, xiāngjiāo děng shūcài shuǐguǒ dōu mǎi de dào, yě yǒu gèshì gèyàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: About the same as Taiwan’s. From Chinese food and Western meals to vegetables and fruits like cabbage and bananas, you can buy them all; there are also all kinds of daily necessities.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我個人覺得便利商店在日本和臺灣能夠成功，除了是二十四小時的，也因為提供的服務非常多，能滿足大家的需求。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我个人觉得便利商店在日本和台湾能够成功，除了是二十四小时的，也因为提供的服务非常多，能满足大家的需求。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ gèrén juéde biànlì shāngdiàn zài Rìběn hàn Táiwān nénggòu chénggōng, chúle shì èrshísì xiǎoshí de, yě yīnwèi tígōng de fúwù fēicháng duō, néng mǎnzú dàjiā de xūqiú.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Personally, I think convenience stores are successful in Japan and Taiwan not only because they are open 24 hours, but also because they provide so many services, meeting everyone’s needs.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 嗯，我同意。法國沒有這樣的商店嗎？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 嗯，我同意。法国没有这样的商店吗？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Èn, wǒ tóngyì. Fǎguó méiyǒu zhèyàng de shāngdiàn ma?
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Mm, I agree. Doesn’t France have stores like this?

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 法國沒有二十四小時的，也沒有這麼多服務。我想主要是因為法國人的想法和工作習慣跟臺灣人不一樣吧。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 法国没有二十四小时的，也没有这么多服务。我想主要是因为法国人的想法和工作习惯跟台湾人不一样吧。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Fǎguó méiyǒu èrshísì xiǎoshí de, yě méiyǒu zhème duō fúwù. Wǒ xiǎng zhǔyào shì yīnwèi Fǎguórén de xiǎngfǎ hàn gōngzuò xíguàn gēn Táiwānrén bù yíyàng ba.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: France doesn’t have 24-hour ones, nor so many services. I think it’s mainly because French people’s mindset and working habits are different from Taiwanese people’s.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我的法國朋友也說，臺灣便利商店的店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒擦桌子，太辛苦了。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我的法国朋友也说，台湾便利商店的店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿擦桌子，太辛苦了。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyou yě shuō, Táiwān biànlì shāngdiàn de diànyuán yìhuǐr zhǔ kāfēi, yìhuǐr cā zhuōzi, tài xīnkǔ le.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: My French friend also said that Taiwanese convenience store clerks make coffee one moment and wipe tables the next; it’s so hard!

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 是啊，他們真的太忙了。（看錶）不好意思，我等一下有個約會，現在得先去送洗衣服了，也順便領點錢。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 是啊，他们真的太忙了。（看表）不好意思，我等一下有个约会，现在得先去送洗衣服了，也顺便领点钱。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Shì a, tāmen zhēnde tài máng le. (Kàn biǎo) Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ děng yíxià yǒu ge yuēhuì, xiànzài děi xiān qù sòngxǐ yīfu le, yě shùnbiàn lǐng diǎn qián.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Yeah, they really are too busy. (Looks at watch) Excuse me, I have an appointment shortly, so I need to go drop off the laundry now and also withdraw some cash on the way.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 朋子
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 附近有一家銀行的自動提款機不收手續費，你可以去那裡領。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 附近有一家银行的自动提款机不收手续费，你可以去那里领。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu yì jiā yínháng de zìdòng tíkuǎnjī bù shōu shǒuxùfèi, nǐ kěyǐ qù nàlǐ lǐng.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: There is an ATM from a nearby bank that doesn’t charge fees; you could withdraw there.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 尚恩
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 沒關係，手續費不過幾塊錢，我在便利商店領算了。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 没关系，手续费不过几块钱，我在便利商店领算了。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Méi guānxi, shǒuxùfèi búguò jǐ kuài qián, wǒ zài biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng suànle.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: That’s fine; the transaction fee is only a few dollars, I might as well just withdraw it at the convenience store.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 在臺灣，許多人的生活離不開超商，所以街上到處都看得到超商，每走幾步路就有一家，有時候還能看到兩家超商連在一起。為什麼超商能吸引顧客不斷地上門呢？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 在台湾，许多人的生活离不开超商，所以街上到处都看得到超商，每走几步路就有一家，有时候还能看到两家超商连在一起。为什么超商能吸引顾客不断地上门呢？
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, xǔduō rén de shēnghuó lí bu kāi chāoshāng, suǒyǐ jiē shàng dàochù dōu kàn de dào chāoshāng, měi zǒu jǐ bù lù jiù yǒu yì jiā, yǒu shíhou hái néng kàndào liǎng jiā chāoshāng lián zài yìqǐ. Wèishénme chāoshāng néng xīyǐn gùkè búduàn de shàngmén ne?
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: In Taiwan, many people cannot do without convenience stores in their daily lives, so convenience stores can be seen everywhere on the streets. There is one every few steps, and sometimes you can even see two stores right next to each other. Why are convenience stores able to attract a steady stream of customers?

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 一提到超商的優點，大家馬上想到的，就是可以買到各式各樣的東西。比如，忽然下雨了，沒帶傘的話，就能趕快進超商買把傘；天氣變冷了，就能買到厚的手套和帽子；要是想喝點兒下午茶，也能買到點心，順便再帶杯咖啡回家。而且在超商，還能付停車費、信用卡費、水電費，連送洗衣服都不是問題。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 一提到超商的优点，大家马上想到的，就是可以买到各式各样的东西。比如，忽然下雨了，没带伞的话，就能赶快进超商买把伞；天气变冷了，就能买到厚的手套和帽子；要是想喝点儿下午茶，也能买到点心，顺便再带杯咖啡回家。而且在超商，还能付停车费、信用卡费、水电费，连送洗衣服都不是问题。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Yì tídào chāoshāng de yōudiǎn, dàjiā mǎshàng xiǎngdào de, jiù shì kěyǐ mǎi dào gèshì gèyàng de dōngxi. Bǐrú, hūrán xiàyǔ le, méi dài sǎn dehuà, jiù néng gǎnkuài jìn chāoshāng mǎi bǎ sǎn; tiānqì biàn lěng le, jiù néng mǎi dào hòu de shǒutào hàn màozi; yàoshi xiǎng hē diǎnr xiàwǔchá, yě néng mǎi dào diǎnxin, shùnbiàn zài dài bēi kāfēi huíjiā. Érqiě zài chāoshāng, hái néng fù tíngchēfèi, xìnyòngkǎfèi, shuǐdiànfèi, lián sòngxǐ yīfu dōu bú shì wèntí.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: When mentioning the merits of convenience stores, what immediately comes to mind is that you can purchase all kinds of goods. For instance, if it suddenly rains and you haven’t brought an umbrella, you can quickly step in to buy one; when the weather turns cold, you can purchase thick gloves and a hat; if you want afternoon tea, you can get a snack and pick up a coffee to take home on the way. What’s more, at convenience stores you can pay parking fees, credit card bills, and utilities; even sending clothes to be washed is no problem at all.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 逛超商也能夠增加不少生活的樂趣，因為超商經常進一些特別的商品來吸引顧客，像外國的零食、飲料和化妝品等；而且有一些超商每經過一段時間，就會舉辦活動，用送神祕小禮物的方式來吸引顧客。不少人為了這些小禮物，一天就去買好幾回。對臺灣人來說，超商就像一個親切的好鄰居，每次進去時，店員都帶著微笑對客人說聲歡迎，他們的服務態度真的很不錯。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 逛超商也能够增加不少生活的乐趣，因为超商经常进一些特别的商品来吸引顾客，像外国的零食、饮料和化妆品等；而且有一些超商每经过一段时间，就会举办活动，用送神秘小礼物的方式来吸引顾客。不少人为了这些小礼物，一天就去买好几回。对台湾人来说，超商就像一个亲切的好邻居，每次进去时，店员都带着微笑对客人说声欢迎，他们的服务态度真的很不错。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Guàng chāoshāng yě nénggòu zēngjiā bù shǎo shēnghuó de lèqù, yīnwèi chāoshāng jīngcháng jìn yìxiē tèbié de shāngpǐn lái xīyǐn gùkè, xiàng wàiguó de língshí, yǐnliào hàn huàzhuāngpǐn děng; érqiě yǒu yìxiē chāoshāng měi jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì jǔbàn huódòng, yòng sòng shénmì xiǎo lǐwù de fāngshì lái xīyǐn gùkè. Bù shǎo rén wèile zhèxiē xiǎo lǐwù, yì tiān jiù qù mǎi hǎojǐ huí. Duì Táiwānrén lái shuō, chāoshāng jiù xiàng yí ge qīnqiè de hǎo línjū, měi cì jìnqu shí, diànyuán dōu dàizhe wēixiào duì kèrén shuō shēng huānyíng, tāmen de fúwù tàidù zhēnde hěn búcuò.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: Browsing convenience stores can also add much fun to daily life, because convenience stores regularly stock special items to attract customers, such as imported snacks, drinks, cosmetics, and more. Furthermore, every so often some convenience stores hold promotional events, using mystery gift giveaways to draw customers. For the sake of these small gifts, many people go make purchases several times a day. To Taiwanese people, the convenience store is like a friendly good neighbor; every time you walk in, the clerk smiles and greets guests with a warm welcome—their service attitude is truly great.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 不過，超商的工作是很辛苦的。在小小幾坪的空間裡，店員一會兒要收錢、找零錢，一會兒又要煮咖啡、幫客人把食物加熱，有時候還要教顧客使用機器買票。如果碰到態度差的顧客或看到滿桌的垃圾，也不能生氣。有顧客抱怨時，公司還會要求店員改善服務品質。想當好一個超商店員，真的不容易。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 不过，超商的工作是很辛苦的。在小小几坪的空间里，店员一会儿要收钱、找零钱，一会儿又要煮咖啡、帮客人把食物加热，有时候还要教顾客使用机器买票。如果碰到态度差的顾客或看到满桌的垃圾，也不能生气。有顾客抱怨时，公司还会要求店员改善服务品质。想当好一个超商店员，真的不容易。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Bùguò, chāoshāng de gōngzuò shì hěn xīnkǔ de. Zài xiǎoxiǎo jǐ píng de kōngjiān lǐ, diànyuán yìhuǐr yào shōuqián, zhǎo língqián, yìhuǐr yòu yào zhǔ kāfēi, bāng kèrén bǎ shíwù jiārè, yǒu shíhou hái yào jiāo gùkè shǐyòng jīqì mǎipiào. Rúguǒ pèng dào tàidù chà de gùkè huò kàndào mǎnzhuō de lājī, yě bù néng shēngqì. Yǒu gùkè bàoyuàn shí, gōngsī hái huì yāoqiú diànyuán gǎishàn fúwù pǐnzhí. Xiǎng dāng hǎo yí ge chāoshāng diànyuán, zhēnde bù róngyì.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: However, convenience store work is very arduous. Within just a few ping of space, the clerk must collect cash and make change one moment, then brew coffee and heat food for customers the next; sometimes they also need to teach customers how to use the ticketing kiosks. Even if they encounter rude customers or see tables strewn with trash, they cannot lose their temper. When a customer complains, the company requires clerks to improve service quality. Being a great convenience store clerk is truly not easy.

LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 超商的功能多、服務速度快，但是也有缺點，比如有些商品比超級市場貴了點兒。不過，以臺灣人的習慣，不需要花太多時間就買得到想要的東西，就算多付一點兒錢也是可以接受的。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 超商的功能多、服务速度快，但是也有缺点，比如有些商品比超级市场贵了点儿。不过，以台湾人的习惯，不需要花太多时间就买得到想要的东西，就算多付一点儿钱也是可以接受的。
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Chāoshāng de gōngnéng duō, fúwù sùdù kuài, dànshì yě yǒu quēdiǎn, bǐrú yǒuxiē shāngpǐn bǐ chāojí shìchǎng guì le diǎnr. Bùguò, yǐ Táiwānrén de xíguàn, bù xūyào huā tài duō shíjiān jiù mǎi de dào xiǎng yào de dōngxi, jiùsuàn duō fù yìdiǎnr qián yě shì kěyǐ jiēshòu de.
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: Convenience stores have many functions and fast service, but there are also disadvantages; for instance, some goods are slightly more expensive than at supermarkets. However, according to Taiwanese habits, being able to buy what you want without spending too much time makes paying a little extra acceptable.

LESSON_TWO_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express that something was already done or known long before using 早就……了.
grammarPages.explanation: 用「早就……了」表示說話者覺得「時間已經很久了」，強調事情發生得很早或知道得很早。Using 早就……了 means that the speaker feels it has already been a long time or that an action occurred well in advance.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 早就 + Verb Phrase + 了

patternRows.english: Convenience stores have had that service for a long time.
Everyone knew this a long time ago.

items.question: How does 早就 differ from 已經?
items.answer: 早就 emphasizes the subjective feeling of 'long before / way ahead of time', whereas 已經 simply states factual completion.

right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le.
right.english: I knew about this a long time ago.

items.question: Can 早就 be used for things that just happened?
items.answer: No. 早就 implies a significant amount of elapsed time; for recent events use 剛才 or 剛剛.

right.english: He went out a long time ago.

text.traditional: 你不是早就計畫好要出國了嗎？怎麼現在才請假呢？
text.simplified: 你不是早就计画好要出国了吗？怎么现在才请假呢？
text.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì zǎojiù jìhuà hǎo yào chūguó le ma? Zěnme xiànzài cái qǐngjià ne?
text.english: Didn't you plan to go abroad a long time ago? Why are you asking for leave only now?

text.traditional: 這家超商不是二十四小時營業的嗎？
text.simplified: 这家超商不是二十四小时营业的吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng bú shì èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè de ma?
text.english: Isn't this convenience store open 24 hours?

text.traditional: 他不是上個月才剛換新工作嗎？
text.simplified: 他不是上个月才刚换新工作吗？
text.pinyin: Tā bú shì shàng ge yuè cái gāng huàn xīn gōngzuò ma?
text.english: Didn't he just switch to a new job last month?

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 不是…嗎 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.correctFeedback: 早就 pairs with 過/了 to emphasize that something was told long ago.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 早就 to emphasize that the announcement occurred well in advance.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express doing a secondary action on the way using 順便.
grammarPages.explanation: 順便 indicates that an action is done conveniently while doing the primary task, without requiring extra trip or special effort.

patternRows.english: Mr. Ji got off work and conveniently took his laptop over to his friend.
I went to the supermarket and picked up milk and eggs on the way.
When introducing the product, mention your own experience while you're at it.

items.question: Can 順便 be used for a special, deliberate trip?
items.answer: No. 順便 means 'in passing / on the way' without going out of your way; for a deliberate trip, say 特地 or 專門.

right.pinyin: Wǒ tēdì zuò fēijī qù kàn nǐ.
right.english: I specially flew to visit you.

items.question: Where is 順便 placed in relation to the secondary action?
items.answer: 順便 sits immediately before the secondary verb phrase that you perform on the way.

right.pinyin: Wǒ qù chāoshāng shùnbiàn mǎi niúnǎi.
right.english: I went to the store and conveniently bought milk.

text.traditional: 紀先生下班經過朋友家時，順便把幫朋友買的筆電送去了。
text.simplified: 纪先生下班经过朋友家时，顺便把帮朋友买的笔电送去了。
text.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng xiàbān jīngguò péngyǒu jiā shí, shùnbiàn bǎ bāng péngyǒu mǎi de bǐdiàn sòng qù le.
text.english: When Mr. Ji passed by his friend's house after work, he dropped off the laptop he bought for him along the way.

text.traditional: 你去便利商店的時候，能不能順便幫我買一杯熱拿鐵？
text.simplified: 你去便利商店的时候，能不能顺便帮我买一杯热拿铁？
text.pinyin: Nǐ qù biànlì shāngdiàn de shíhòu, néng bù néng shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi yì bēi rè nátiě?
text.english: When you go to the convenience store, could you buy a hot latte for me while you're at it?

text.traditional: 小龍跟顧客介紹新產品的時候，都會順便說說他自己使用的經驗。
text.simplified: 小龙跟顾客介绍新产品的时候，都会顺便说说他自己使用的经验。
text.pinyin: Xiǎolóng gēn gùkè jièshào xīn chǎnpǐn de shíhòu, dōu huì shùnbiàn shuōshuō tā zìjǐ shǐyòng de jīngyàn.
text.english: When Xiaolong introduces new products to customers, he always shares his own experience along the way.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 順便 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.correctFeedback: 順便 introduces a secondary request done along with the primary trip.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 順便 for an action done on the way without extra trouble.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe two alternating actions or rapidly changing conditions using 一會兒…一會兒….
grammarPages.explanation: This structure describes alternating actions occurring in quick succession, or states changing repeatedly.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一會兒 + Action 1 + 一會兒 + Action 2

columns.meaning: variant of 結賬|结账[jie2 zhang4]

patternRows.english: The clerk brews coffee one moment, and helps check out customers the next.
The wind is strong one minute, and light the next.
He glances at his phone one moment, and checks his watch the next.

items.question: Can 一會兒…一會兒… describe simultaneous actions?
items.answer: No. It describes alternating actions in quick succession; for simultaneous actions, use 一邊…一邊….
items.wrongTraditional: 他一會兒吃飯一會兒看電視。
items.wrongSimplified: 他一会儿吃饭一会儿看电视。

right.traditional: 他一邊吃飯一邊看電視。
right.simplified: 他一边吃饭一边看电视。
right.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chīfàn yìbiān kàn diànshì.
right.english: He is eating while watching television.

items.question: Can 一會兒 be used with a single verb?
items.answer: In this pattern, both parts must repeat (一會兒 A，一會兒 B) to show alternation.

right.traditional: 他今天一會兒哭一會兒笑。
right.simplified: 他今天一会儿哭一会儿笑。
right.pinyin: Tā jīntiān yíhuìr kū yíhuìr xiào.
right.english: Today he cries one moment and laughs the next.

text.traditional: 今天整天下雨，風一會兒大，一會兒小，這樣的天氣出門真麻煩！
text.simplified: 今天整天下雨，风一会儿大，一会儿小，这样的天气出门真麻烦！
text.pinyin: Jīntiān zhěng tiān xiàyǔ, fēng yìhuǐr dà, yìhuǐr xiǎo, zhèyàng de tiānqì chūmén zhēn máfan!
text.english: It rained all day today; the wind was strong one moment and calm the next. Going out in weather like this is really troublesome!

text.traditional: 店員一會兒幫客人微波便當，一會兒忙著結帳，一刻都停不下來。
text.simplified: 店员一会儿帮客人微波便当，一会儿忙着结帐，一刻都停不下来。
text.pinyin: Diànyuán yìhuǐr bāng kèrén wēibō biàndāng, yìhuǐr máng zhe jiézhàng, yí kè dōu tíng bù xiàlái.
text.english: The clerk microwaved bento for customers one moment, and bustled checking out the next, unable to stop for a second.

words.meaning: variant of 結賬|结账[jie2 zhang4]

text.traditional: 妹妹做功課的時候很不專心，一會兒吃零食，一會兒玩手機。
text.simplified: 妹妹做功课的时候很不专心，一会儿吃零食，一会儿玩手机。
text.pinyin: Mèimei zuò gōngkè de shíhòu hěn bù zhuānxīn, yìhuǐr chī língshí, yìhuǐr wán shǒujī.
text.english: My younger sister is very unfocused when doing homework, eating snacks one minute and playing on her phone the next.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 一會兒…一會兒… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.correctFeedback: 一會兒……一會兒…… links contrasting actions alternating rapidly.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 一會兒 to pair with the second 一會兒 for rapid alternation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give up a plan or accept a compromised situation using 算了.
grammarPages.explanation: 算了 indicates dropping a plan or settling for an alternative when facing difficulties or fatigue.

patternRows.english: Work is exhausting; let's just grab a boxed meal from the convenience store.
Since it's raining heavily, let's just stay home today.
The phone is damaged too badly; might as well just buy a new one.

items.question: Can 算了 mean 'calculated correctly'?
items.answer: As an idiom, 算了 means 'forget it / let it drop'; to calculate, use 算好了.

right.pinyin: Zhè dào shùxué tí wǒ suàn hǎo le.
right.english: I have calculated this math problem.

items.question: Can 算了 precede a noun directly?
items.answer: 算了 is a predicate exclamation or clause-final marker; it never acts as a noun modifier.

right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suànle ba.

text.traditional: 這幾天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮飯，我想就去便利商店買算了。
text.simplified: 这几天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮饭，我想就去便利商店买算了。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān gōngzuò máng sǐ le, wǎnshàng bù xiǎng zhǔfàn, wǒ xiǎng jiù qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi suàn le.
text.english: Work has been crazy busy these days and I don't feel like cooking; I might as well just buy something at the convenience store.

text.traditional: 外面雨下得這麼大，我看今天的爬山行程就算了吧。
text.simplified: 外面雨下得这么大，我看今天的爬山行程就算了吧。
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǔ xià de zhème dà, wǒ kàn jīntiān de páshān xíngchéng jiù suàn le ba.
text.english: It's raining so hard outside; I think we should just skip today's hike.

text.traditional: 修這輛老舊的機車要花幾萬元，我看買台新的算了。
text.simplified: 修这辆老旧的机车要花几万元，我看买台新的算了。
text.pinyin: Xiū zhè liàng lǎojiù de jīchē yào huā jǐ wàn yuán, wǒ kàn mǎi tái xīn de suàn le.
text.english: Fixing this old scooter costs tens of thousands; I think we might as well just buy a new one.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 算了 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 排隊要等二十分鐘，太久了，我們去別家吃
segments.simplified: 排队要等二十分钟，太久了，我们去别家吃

segments.hint: Colloquial phrase for accepting a compromise.

questions.correctFeedback: 算了 placed after an alternative action indicates a practical compromise.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 算了 to drop the long wait and choose another restaurant.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 便利商店真方便 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 你提著一大包東西，要去哪裡啊？
lines.simplified: 你提着一大包东西，要去哪里啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tízhe yí dà bāo dōngxi, yào qù nǎlǐ a?
lines.english: You’re carrying a large bag of things; where are you off to?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我要去便利商店送洗衣服。
lines.simplified: 我要去便利商店送洗衣服。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn sòngxǐ yīfu.
lines.english: I’m going to the convenience store to send clothes for dry cleaning.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 臺灣的便利商店有送洗衣服的服務，我怎麼不知道？
lines.simplified: 台湾的便利商店有送洗衣服的服务，我怎么不知道？
lines.pinyin: Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu sòngxǐ yīfu de fúwù, wǒ zěnme bù zhīdào?
lines.english: Taiwan’s convenience stores have laundry services? How did I not know?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 早就有了，挺方便的。我剛到臺灣時，跟朋友去便利商店，被嚇了一跳。
lines.simplified: 早就有了，挺方便的。我刚到台湾时，跟朋友去便利商店，被吓了一跳。
lines.pinyin: Zǎo jiù yǒu le, tǐng fāngbiàn de. Wǒ gāng dào Táiwān shí, gēn péngyou qù biànlì shāngdiàn, bèi xià le yí tiào.
lines.english: They’ve had it for a long time; it’s quite convenient. When I first arrived in Taiwan, I went to a convenience store with a friend and was shocked.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 怎麼了？被什麼事嚇了一跳？
lines.simplified: 怎么了？被什么事吓了一跳？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme le? Bèi shénme shì xià le yí tiào?
lines.english: What happened? What shocked you?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我沒想到臺灣的便利商店有這麼多服務。像領錢、買票，還有收電話費、水電費什麼的。
lines.simplified: 我没想到台湾的便利商店有这么多服务。像领钱、买票，还有收电话费、水电费什么的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu zhème duō fúwù. Xiàng lǐngqián, mǎipiào, hái yǒu shōu diànhuàfèi, shuǐdiànfèi shénmede.
lines.english: I never expected Taiwan’s convenience stores to offer so many services. Like withdrawing money, buying tickets, plus collecting phone bills, utilities, and so on.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 對，真的很多。我覺得現在臺灣的便利商店比以前方便，比如說，提供休息空間，讓客人坐下來，好好地吃個東西、喝點飲料。
lines.simplified: 对，真的很多。我觉得现在台湾的便利商店比以前方便，比如说，提供休息空间，让客人坐下来，好好地吃个东西、喝点饮料。
lines.pinyin: Duì, zhēnde hěn duō. Wǒ juéde xiànzài Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn, bǐrú shuō, tígōng xiūxí kōngjiān, ràng kèrén zuò xiàlai, hǎohāode chī ge dōngxi, hē diǎn yǐnliào.
lines.english: Right, really a lot. I feel Taiwan’s convenience stores now are more convenient than before; for instance, providing seating areas so customers can sit down and comfortably have a bite to eat or drink a beverage.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 是啊。現在我早晚都去，有時候整個下午都在那裡看書、寫功課。如果餓了，就順便買個泡麵，還能免費使用熱水，真方便。
lines.simplified: 是啊。现在我早晚都去，有时候整个下午都在那里看书、写功课。如果饿了，就顺便买个泡面，还能免费使用热水，真方便。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ zǎowǎn dōu qù, yǒu shíhou zhěng ge xiàwǔ dōu zài nàlǐ kànshū, xiě gōngkè. Rúguǒ è le, jiù shùnbiàn mǎi ge pàomiàn, hái néng miǎnfèi shǐyòng rèshuǐ, zhēn fāngbiàn.
lines.english: Yeah. Now I go both morning and night; sometimes I spend the whole afternoon there reading and doing homework. If I get hungry, I casually buy instant noodles, and can even use hot water for free; it’s really convenient.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我來不及做早餐的話，就去那裡買個饅頭、牛奶。有時候也去買最愛的熱狗跟汽水，雖然沒什麼營養，但是可以讓心情變得更好，哈哈哈！
lines.simplified: 我来不及做早餐的话，就去那里买个馒头、牛奶。有时候也去买最爱的热狗跟汽水，虽然没什么营养，但是可以让心情变得更好，哈哈哈！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ láibují zuò zǎocān dehuà, jiù qù nàlǐ mǎi ge mántou, niúnǎi. Yǒu shíhou yě qù mǎi zuì ài de règǒu gēn qìshuǐ, suīrán méi shénme yíngyǎng, dànshì kěyǐ ràng xīnqíng biàn de gèng hǎo, hāhāhā!
lines.english: If I don’t have time to make breakfast, I go there to buy a steamed bun and milk. Sometimes I also buy my favorite hot dog and soda; although not very nutritious, it puts me in a better mood, hahaha!

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 是啊。對了，我聽說日本的便利商店也很方便，商品也很多。
lines.simplified: 是啊。对了，我听说日本的便利商店也很方便，商品也很多。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Duì le, wǒ tīngshuō Rìběn de biànlì shāngdiàn yě hěn fāngbiàn, shāngpǐn yě hěn duō.
lines.english: Yeah. By the way, I heard convenience stores in Japan are also very convenient, and have lots of merchandise.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 跟臺灣的差不多。從中餐、西餐，到白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果都買得到，也有各式各樣的生活用品。
lines.simplified: 跟台湾的差不多。从中餐、西餐，到白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果都买得到，也有各式各样的生活用品。
lines.pinyin: Gēn Táiwān de chàbùduō. Cóng zhōngcān, xīcān, dào báicài, xiāngjiāo děng shūcài shuǐguǒ dōu mǎi de dào, yě yǒu gèshì gèyàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
lines.english: About the same as Taiwan’s. From Chinese food and Western meals to vegetables and fruits like cabbage and bananas, you can buy them all; there are also all kinds of daily necessities.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 我個人覺得便利商店在日本和臺灣能夠成功，除了是二十四小時的，也因為提供的服務非常多，能滿足大家的需求。
lines.simplified: 我个人觉得便利商店在日本和台湾能够成功，除了是二十四小时的，也因为提供的服务非常多，能满足大家的需求。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gèrén juéde biànlì shāngdiàn zài Rìběn hàn Táiwān nénggòu chénggōng, chúle shì èrshísì xiǎoshí de, yě yīnwèi tígōng de fúwù fēicháng duō, néng mǎnzú dàjiā de xūqiú.
lines.english: Personally, I think convenience stores are successful in Japan and Taiwan not only because they are open 24 hours, but also because they provide so many services, meeting everyone’s needs.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 嗯，我同意。法國沒有這樣的商店嗎？
lines.simplified: 嗯，我同意。法国没有这样的商店吗？
lines.pinyin: Èn, wǒ tóngyì. Fǎguó méiyǒu zhèyàng de shāngdiàn ma?
lines.english: Mm, I agree. Doesn’t France have stores like this?

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 法國沒有二十四小時的，也沒有這麼多服務。我想主要是因為法國人的想法和工作習慣跟臺灣人不一樣吧。
lines.simplified: 法国没有二十四小时的，也没有这么多服务。我想主要是因为法国人的想法和工作习惯跟台湾人不一样吧。
lines.pinyin: Fǎguó méiyǒu èrshísì xiǎoshí de, yě méiyǒu zhème duō fúwù. Wǒ xiǎng zhǔyào shì yīnwèi Fǎguórén de xiǎngfǎ hàn gōngzuò xíguàn gēn Táiwānrén bù yíyàng ba.
lines.english: France doesn’t have 24-hour ones, nor so many services. I think it’s mainly because French people’s mindset and working habits are different from Taiwanese people’s.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 我的法國朋友也說，臺灣便利商店的店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒擦桌子，太辛苦了。
lines.simplified: 我的法国朋友也说，台湾便利商店的店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿擦桌子，太辛苦了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyou yě shuō, Táiwān biànlì shāngdiàn de diànyuán yìhuǐr zhǔ kāfēi, yìhuǐr cā zhuōzi, tài xīnkǔ le.
lines.english: My French friend also said that Taiwanese convenience store clerks make coffee one moment and wipe tables the next; it’s so hard!

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 是啊，他們真的太忙了。（看錶）不好意思，我等一下有個約會，現在得先去送洗衣服了，也順便領點錢。
lines.simplified: 是啊，他们真的太忙了。（看表）不好意思，我等一下有个约会，现在得先去送洗衣服了，也顺便领点钱。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, tāmen zhēnde tài máng le. (Kàn biǎo) Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ děng yíxià yǒu ge yuēhuì, xiànzài děi xiān qù sòngxǐ yīfu le, yě shùnbiàn lǐng diǎn qián.
lines.english: Yeah, they really are too busy. (Looks at watch) Excuse me, I have an appointment shortly, so I need to go drop off the laundry now and also withdraw some cash on the way.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 附近有一家銀行的自動提款機不收手續費，你可以去那裡領。
lines.simplified: 附近有一家银行的自动提款机不收手续费，你可以去那里领。
lines.pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu yì jiā yínháng de zìdòng tíkuǎnjī bù shōu shǒuxùfèi, nǐ kěyǐ qù nàlǐ lǐng.
lines.english: There is an ATM from a nearby bank that doesn’t charge fees; you could withdraw there.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 沒關係，手續費不過幾塊錢，我在便利商店領算了。
lines.simplified: 没关系，手续费不过几块钱，我在便利商店领算了。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi, shǒuxùfèi búguò jǐ kuài qián, wǒ zài biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng suànle.
lines.english: That’s fine; the transaction fee is only a few dollars, I might as well just withdraw it at the convenience store.

lines.speaker: 朋子
lines.traditional: 嗯，你說的對。
lines.simplified: 嗯，你说得对。
lines.pinyin: Èn, nǐ shuō de duì.
lines.english: Mm, you’re right.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express separating things or moving away from a spot using the complement 開.
grammarPages.explanation: 「開」當結果補語，有「本來在一起的東西分離」的意思，例如：打開、拉開。「開」也有「人或物離開本來的地方」的意思，例如：走開、離開、拿開。也可以在結果補語「開」的前面加上可能補語「得」或「不」，例如：打得開、打不開、走得開、走不開。開 as a complement denotes physical separation or departure from a position.
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 開 / 得開 / 不開

patternRows.english: Many people cannot do without convenience stores.

items.question: How does complement 開 differ from 開始?
items.answer: Complement 開 indicates separation or leaving a spot (打不開, 走不開). 開始 indicates the onset of an action.

items.question: What does 走不開 mean?
items.answer: 走不開 means being tied up and unable to leave one's post, not physical inability to walk.

right.pinyin: Wǒ zài zuòfàn, xiànzài zǒu bu kāi.
right.english: I am cooking and cannot step away right now.

text.traditional: 這個門我開了半天就是打不開，你過來看看。
text.simplified: 这个门我开了半天就是打不开，你过来看看。
text.pinyin: Zhège mén wǒ kāi le bàntiān jiùshì dǎ bù kāi, nǐ guòlái kànkan.
text.english: I've been trying to open this door for ages, but it simply won't open; come take a look.

text.traditional: 醫生勸他少喝點酒，但他就是不肯改掉這個壞習慣。
text.simplified: 医生劝他少喝点酒，但他就是不肯改掉这个坏习惯。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng quàn tā shǎo hē diǎn jiǔ, dàn tā jiùshì bù kěn gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn.
text.english: The doctor advised him to drink less, but he simply refuses to drop this bad habit.

text.traditional: 不管大家怎麼鼓勵他，他就是不願意上台表演。
text.simplified: 不管大家怎么鼓励他，他就是不愿意上台表演。
text.pinyin: Bùguǎn dàjiā zěnme gǔlì tā, tā jiùshì bú yuànyì shàngtái biǎoyǎn.
text.english: No matter how everyone encourages him, he simply refuses to perform on stage.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express a result achieved through a process or time period using 經過.
grammarPages.explanation: 經過 indicates undergoing a certain process, experience, or period of time that leads to an outcome.

patternRows.english: Through three months of hard work, their Chinese has improved a lot.
After meeting and discussing, everyone decided to add more equipment.
Through the doctor's attentive care, the patient finally recovered.

items.question: Can 經過 mean passing by a physical location?
items.answer: Yes, as a verb it means passing by; as a preposition here, it means 'through the process of'.

right.traditional: 經過超商時我想買東西。
right.simplified: 经过超商时我想买东西。
right.pinyin: Jīngguò chāoshāng shí wǒ xiǎng mǎi dōngxi.
right.english: When passing by the store, I wanted to buy something.

items.question: Can 經過 be followed immediately by an adjective without a process?
items.answer: 經過 introduces an experience or process, not an adjective attribute.

text.traditional: 他以前一句中文都不會說，才經過三個月，現在不但朋友多了，買東西也沒問題了。
text.simplified: 他以前一句中文都不会说，才经过三个月，现在不但朋友多了，买东西也没问题了。
text.pinyin: Tā yǐqián yí jù zhōngwén dōu bú huì shuō, cái jīngguò sān ge yuè, xiànzài búdàn péngyǒu duō le, mǎi dōngxi yě méi wèntí le.
text.english: He couldn't speak a single sentence of Chinese before; after just three months, not only does he have more friends, but shopping is no problem either.

text.traditional: 我們社區的健身用品不夠，經過開會討論，決定下個月增加兩輛健身腳踏車。
text.simplified: 我们社区的健身用品不够，经过开会讨论，决定下个月增加两辆健身脚踏车。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen shèqū de jiànshēn yòngpǐn bú gòu, jīngguò kāihuì tǎolùn, juédìng xià ge yuè zēngjiā liǎng liàng jiànshēn jiǎotàchē.
text.english: Our community's exercise equipment was insufficient; through meeting discussions, we decided to add two exercise bikes next month.

text.traditional: 經過多年的實習與摸索，他終於成了一名受人尊敬的好導演。
text.simplified: 经过多年的实习与摸索，他终于成了一名受人尊敬的好导演。
text.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de shíxí yǔ mōsuǒ, tā zhōngyú chéng le yì míng shòu rén zūnjìng de hǎo dǎoyǎn.
text.english: Through years of practice and exploration, he finally became a respected director.

segments.simplified: 这件事，我觉得应该好好把握机会。

questions.repairFeedback: Use 經過 for having experienced a life event.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express the method or instrument used to achieve an objective using 用…來….
grammarPages.explanation: This structure indicates using a specific tool, method, or medium to perform an action or reach a goal.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 用 + Tool / Method + 來 + Action

patternRows.english: Many people use smartphones to handle daily affairs.
Confucius used storytelling to teach his students life principles.
People collect reward points to redeem delicious meals.

items.question: Can 來 be omitted in the 用…來… pattern?
items.answer: 來 links the instrument/means to the purpose; omitting it weakens the purposive connection.

right.pinyin: Tā yòng zhè zhī bǐ lái xiězì.
right.english: He uses this pen to write.

items.question: Can the purpose in 來 precede the tool in 用?
items.answer: No. The order is always Tool/Means first (用 X), then Purpose second (來 Y).

right.english: He uses a pen to write.

text.traditional: 現在手機的功能很強，很多人都用手機來處理日常事情。
text.simplified: 现在手机的功能很强，很多人都用手机来处理日常事情。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài shǒujī de gōngnéng hěn qiáng, hěn duō rén dōu yòng shǒujī lái chǔlǐ rìcháng shìqing.
text.english: Smartphones have powerful functions nowadays; many people use phones to handle daily affairs.

text.traditional: 孔子常用講故事的方式來告訴學生做人做事的道理。
text.simplified: 孔子常用讲故事的方式来告诉学生做人做事的道理。

text.english: Confucius often used storytelling to teach his students principles of conduct.

text.traditional: 現代人常用通訊軟體來跟世界各地的朋友保持聯繫。
text.simplified: 现代人常用通讯軟体来跟世界各地的朋友保持联繫。
text.pinyin: Xiàndàirén cháng yòng tōngxùn ruǎntǐ lái gēn shìjiè gèdì de péngyǒu bǎochí liánxì.
text.english: Modern people often use messaging apps to keep in touch with friends around the world.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 臺灣的超商 · Convenience Stores in Taiwan

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 在臺灣，許多人的生活離不開超商，所以街上到處都看得到超商，每走幾步路就有一家，有時候還能看到兩家超商連在一起。為什麼超商能吸引顧客不斷地上門呢？
lines.simplified: 在台湾，许多人的生活离不开超商，所以街上到处都看得到超商，每走几步路就有一家，有时候还能看到两家超商连在一起。为什么超商能吸引顾客不断地上门呢？
lines.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, xǔduō rén de shēnghuó lí bu kāi chāoshāng, suǒyǐ jiē shàng dàochù dōu kàn de dào chāoshāng, měi zǒu jǐ bù lù jiù yǒu yì jiā, yǒu shíhou hái néng kàndào liǎng jiā chāoshāng lián zài yìqǐ. Wèishénme chāoshāng néng xīyǐn gùkè búduàn de shàngmén ne?
lines.english: In Taiwan, many people cannot do without convenience stores in their daily lives, so convenience stores can be seen everywhere on the streets. There is one every few steps, and sometimes you can even see two stores right next to each other. Why are convenience stores able to attract a steady stream of customers?

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 一提到超商的優點，大家馬上想到的，就是可以買到各式各樣的東西。比如，忽然下雨了，沒帶傘的話，就能趕快進超商買把傘；天氣變冷了，就能買到厚的手套和帽子；要是想喝點兒下午茶，也能買到點心，順便再帶杯咖啡回家。而且在超商，還能付停車費、信用卡費、水電費，連送洗衣服都不是問題。
lines.simplified: 一提到超商的优点，大家马上想到的，就是可以买到各式各样的东西。比如，忽然下雨了，没带伞的话，就能赶快进超商买把伞；天气变冷了，就能买到厚的手套和帽子；要是想喝点儿下午茶，也能买到点心，顺便再带杯咖啡回家。而且在超商，还能付停车费、信用卡费、水电费，连送洗衣服都不是问题。
lines.pinyin: Yì tídào chāoshāng de yōudiǎn, dàjiā mǎshàng xiǎngdào de, jiù shì kěyǐ mǎi dào gèshì gèyàng de dōngxi. Bǐrú, hūrán xiàyǔ le, méi dài sǎn dehuà, jiù néng gǎnkuài jìn chāoshāng mǎi bǎ sǎn; tiānqì biàn lěng le, jiù néng mǎi dào hòu de shǒutào hàn màozi; yàoshi xiǎng hē diǎnr xiàwǔchá, yě néng mǎi dào diǎnxin, shùnbiàn zài dài bēi kāfēi huíjiā. Érqiě zài chāoshāng, hái néng fù tíngchēfèi, xìnyòngkǎfèi, shuǐdiànfèi, lián sòngxǐ yīfu dōu bú shì wèntí.
lines.english: When mentioning the merits of convenience stores, what immediately comes to mind is that you can purchase all kinds of goods. For instance, if it suddenly rains and you haven’t brought an umbrella, you can quickly step in to buy one; when the weather turns cold, you can purchase thick gloves and a hat; if you want afternoon tea, you can get a snack and pick up a coffee to take home on the way. What’s more, at convenience stores you can pay parking fees, credit card bills, and utilities; even sending clothes to be washed is no problem at all.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 逛超商也能夠增加不少生活的樂趣，因為超商經常進一些特別的商品來吸引顧客，像外國的零食、飲料和化妝品等；而且有一些超商每經過一段時間，就會舉辦活動，用送神祕小禮物的方式來吸引顧客。不少人為了這些小禮物，一天就去買好幾回。對臺灣人來說，超商就像一個親切的好鄰居，每次進去時，店員都帶著微笑對客人說聲歡迎，他們的服務態度真的很不錯。
lines.simplified: 逛超商也能够增加不少生活的乐趣，因为超商经常进一些特别的商品来吸引顾客，像外国的零食、饮料和化妆品等；而且有一些超商每经过一段时间，就会举办活动，用送神秘小礼物的方式来吸引顾客。不少人为了这些小礼物，一天就去买好几回。对台湾人来说，超商就像一个亲切的好邻居，每次进去时，店员都带着微笑对客人说声欢迎，他们的服务态度真的很不错。
lines.pinyin: Guàng chāoshāng yě nénggòu zēngjiā bù shǎo shēnghuó de lèqù, yīnwèi chāoshāng jīngcháng jìn yìxiē tèbié de shāngpǐn lái xīyǐn gùkè, xiàng wàiguó de língshí, yǐnliào hàn huàzhuāngpǐn děng; érqiě yǒu yìxiē chāoshāng měi jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì jǔbàn huódòng, yòng sòng shénmì xiǎo lǐwù de fāngshì lái xīyǐn gùkè. Bù shǎo rén wèile zhèxiē xiǎo lǐwù, yì tiān jiù qù mǎi hǎojǐ huí. Duì Táiwānrén lái shuō, chāoshāng jiù xiàng yí ge qīnqiè de hǎo línjū, měi cì jìnqu shí, diànyuán dōu dàizhe wēixiào duì kèrén shuō shēng huānyíng, tāmen de fúwù tàidù zhēnde hěn búcuò.
lines.english: Browsing convenience stores can also add much fun to daily life, because convenience stores regularly stock special items to attract customers, such as imported snacks, drinks, cosmetics, and more. Furthermore, every so often some convenience stores hold promotional events, using mystery gift giveaways to draw customers. For the sake of these small gifts, many people go make purchases several times a day. To Taiwanese people, the convenience store is like a friendly good neighbor; every time you walk in, the clerk smiles and greets guests with a warm welcome—their service attitude is truly great.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 不過，超商的工作是很辛苦的。在小小幾坪的空間裡，店員一會兒要收錢、找零錢，一會兒又要煮咖啡、幫客人把食物加熱，有時候還要教顧客使用機器買票。如果碰到態度差的顧客或看到滿桌的垃圾，也不能生氣。有顧客抱怨時，公司還會要求店員改善服務品質。想當好一個超商店員，真的不容易。
lines.simplified: 不过，超商的工作是很辛苦的。在小小几坪的空间里，店员一会儿要收钱、找零钱，一会儿又要煮咖啡、帮客人把食物加热，有时候还要教顾客使用机器买票。如果碰到态度差的顾客或看到满桌的垃圾，也不能生气。有顾客抱怨时，公司还会要求店员改善服务品质。想当好一个超商店员，真的不容易。
lines.pinyin: Bùguò, chāoshāng de gōngzuò shì hěn xīnkǔ de. Zài xiǎoxiǎo jǐ píng de kōngjiān lǐ, diànyuán yìhuǐr yào shōuqián, zhǎo língqián, yìhuǐr yòu yào zhǔ kāfēi, bāng kèrén bǎ shíwù jiārè, yǒu shíhou hái yào jiāo gùkè shǐyòng jīqì mǎipiào. Rúguǒ pèng dào tàidù chà de gùkè huò kàndào mǎnzhuō de lājī, yě bù néng shēngqì. Yǒu gùkè bàoyuàn shí, gōngsī hái huì yāoqiú diànyuán gǎishàn fúwù pǐnzhí. Xiǎng dāng hǎo yí ge chāoshāng diànyuán, zhēnde bù róngyì.
lines.english: However, convenience store work is very arduous. Within just a few ping of space, the clerk must collect cash and make change one moment, then brew coffee and heat food for customers the next; sometimes they also need to teach customers how to use the ticketing kiosks. Even if they encounter rude customers or see tables strewn with trash, they cannot lose their temper. When a customer complains, the company requires clerks to improve service quality. Being a great convenience store clerk is truly not easy.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 超商的功能多、服務速度快，但是也有缺點，比如有些商品比超級市場貴了點兒。不過，以臺灣人的習慣，不需要花太多時間就買得到想要的東西，就算多付一點兒錢也是可以接受的。
lines.simplified: 超商的功能多、服务速度快，但是也有缺点，比如有些商品比超级市场贵了点儿。不过，以台湾人的习惯，不需要花太多时间就买得到想要的东西，就算多付一点儿钱也是可以接受的。
lines.pinyin: Chāoshāng de gōngnéng duō, fúwù sùdù kuài, dànshì yě yǒu quēdiǎn, bǐrú yǒuxiē shāngpǐn bǐ chāojí shìchǎng guì le diǎnr. Bùguò, yǐ Táiwānrén de xíguàn, bù xūyào huā tài duō shíjiān jiù mǎi de dào xiǎng yào de dōngxi, jiùsuàn duō fù yìdiǎnr qián yě shì kěyǐ jiēshòu de.
lines.english: Convenience stores have many functions and fast service, but there are also disadvantages; for instance, some goods are slightly more expensive than at supermarkets. However, according to Taiwanese habits, being able to buy what you want without spending too much time makes paying a little extra acceptable.
